Secret Compartment.name: Secret Compartment
Secret Compartment.description: A secret pocket on the inside of the armor capable of concealing an item a few inches thick and a few feet long/wide.

Built in X.name: Built in X
Built in X.description: An item such as a weapon or shield can be attached to the armor, making it immune to any disarming attacks. The item still requires the appropriate number of hands to wield.

Medical Kit.name: Medical Kit
Medical Kit.description: The action cost of healing via knowledge skill is reduced to a swift action.

Alchemic Suite.name: Medical Kit
Alchemic Suite.description: The action cost of alchemy is reduced to a swift action, and the wearer gains a stacking placed roll on alchemy checks

Casting.name: Casting
Casting.description: The shield no longer inhibits casting.

Runic Inscription.name: Runic Inscription
Runic Inscription.description: + 1 stacking placed roll on all metamagic checks

Dashing Style.name: Dashing Style
Dashing Style.description: + 1 stacking placed roll on all interpersonal checks

Grappling Hook.name: Grappling Hook
Grappling Hook.description: Character attaches a grappling hook with 30’ of reach to their armor. Requires a movement action to use. Can only latch onto sturdy objects.

ability.description: Character attaches a grappling hook with 30’ of reach to their armor. Requires a movement action to use. Can only latch onto sturdy objects.
ability.name: Grappling Hook

Advanced Grappling Hook.name: Advanced Grappling Hook
Advanced Grappling Hook.description: Character attaches a grappling hook with a reach equal to their movement. Requires a movement action to use. Can be used to grapple onto targets with an attack roll (Core Action, or as part of a grappling attack.)

ability.description: Character attaches a grappling hook with a reach equal to their movement. Requires a movement action to use. Can be used to grapple onto targets with an attack roll (Core Action, or as part of a grappling attack.)
ability.name: Advanced Grappling Hook

Collapseable.name: Collapseable
Collapseable.description: The Armor or shield can collapse to be the size of the character’s palm (no weight change) as a swift action.

Ejectible X.name: Ejectible X
Ejectible X.description: Characters can launch a potion, armor, weapon, or other item as a swift action, up to 40’.

ability.description: Characters can launch a potion, armor, weapon, or other item as a swift action, up to 40’.
ability.name: Ejectible X

Fortress Shield.name: Fortress Shield
Fortress Shield.description: The character can plant their shield into the ground, allowing a character to take cover behind it. Selenium, Illastrium, and Oricalcum shields provide exceptionally protective cover.

ability.description: The character can plant their shield into the ground, allowing a character to take cover behind it. Selenium, Illastrium, and Oricalcum shields provide exceptionally protective cover.
ability.name: Fortress Shield

Orichalcum.name: Orichalcum
Orichalcum.description: 1 placed roll on any attempts to resist an ability.

Selenium.name: Selenium
Selenium.description: The armor can hold double the normal maximum difficulty score of enchantments (20, instead of 10.) Crafter’s ranks in crafting are doubled when working with this material.

Illiastrium.name: Illiastrium
Illiastrium.description: Mundane Damage Reduction 4, Negates a weapon’s bonus damage (Any additional damage beyond base damage die of weapon), unless it is a Magical Damage type; character no longer benefits from armor DVs.

Invisible Ink.name: Invisible Ink
Invisible Ink.description: The item itself is invisible, allowing it to be seen through, showing whatever is beneath it.

Vacuum Proof.name: Vacuum Proof
Vacuum Proof.description: Makes the armor vacuum-proof (Protecting them from some hostile environmental conditions). Has a life support system that lasts for up an hour, that is restored upon a rest period.

Dragon Scales.name: Invisible Ink
Dragon Scales.description: Resistance to a single type of mundane damage of the character’s choosing.

Golden.name: Golden
Golden.description: + 1 stacking placed roll on all performance checks.

Hood.name: Hood
Hood.description: + 1 stacking placed roll on all subtlety checks.

Cape.name: Cape
Cape.description: + 1 stacking placed roll on all acrobatics checks.

Sequenced Magic.name: Sequenced Magic
Sequenced Magic.description: Spell resistance checks set by the caster are always 11 + the caster’s ranks in crafting.

Elemental Resistance.name: Elemental Resistance
Elemental Resistance.description: Resistance to a single type of elemental damage of the character’s choosing.

Aegisite.name: Aegisite
Aegisite.description: Resistance to a single type of elemental damage of the character’s choosing.

Ice Infusion.name: Ice Infusion
Ice Infusion.description: Slows the first target that successfully strikes the character with an attack roll, in a round, until the end of their next turn

Astral Infusion.name: Astral Infusion
Astral Infusion.description: Inflicts 1d10 pure magic damage to the first target that successfully strikes the character with an attack roll in a round.

Fire Infusion.name: Fire Infusion
Fire Infusion.description: Inflicts an instance of suffering (fire) on the first target that successfully strikes the character with an attack roll in a round

Protective Field.name: Protective Field
Protective Field.description: + 1 to the roll on any attempts to resist an ability.

Chronosteel.name: Chronosteel
Chronosteel.description: Gain a placed roll on initiative checks and allows the character to dismiss and summon the item from a pocket dimension as a swift action.

Disguised Armor.name: Disguised Armor
Disguised Armor.description: Twice per day, change the visual appearance of the armor within reason.

Sensing Armor.name: Sensing Armor
Sensing Armor.description: + 1 stacking placed roll on Awareness checks

Charming Allure.name: Charming Allure
Charming Allure.description: Enemies have a displaced roll on to hit rolls against the character if the character hasn’t taken any hostile actions against them.

Restorative Armor.name: Restorative Armor
Restorative Armor.description: All healing this character gives/receives is increased by 2.

Natural Lighting.name: Natural Lighting
Natural Lighting.description: Wears armor emits light in a 40’ radius around them.

Leeching Infusion.name: Leeching Infusion
Leeching Infusion.description: Wearer recovers 10 HP at the end of each turn, up to a maximum daily total of 80, restored after a complete rest period.

Nightvision.name: Nightvision
Nightvision.description: Wearer’s vision in natural darkness is equal to their normal vision.

Living Armor.name: Living Armor
Living Armor.description: The armor has a 10 HP temporary barrier, restored after a complete rest period.

Natural Armor.name: Natural Armor
Natural Armor.description: Wearer gains d12 claws and a d12 bite.

Adaptive Armor.name: Adaptive Armor
Adaptive Armor.description: Wearer is unaffected by temperature, and the wearer does not need to breathe as long as they are wearing the armor.

Auric Armor.name: Auric Armor
Auric Armor.description: The wearer’s maximum HP is set to 10 and cannot be increased. At the start of each turn, the wearer receives a HP shield of 35. This shield reapplies itself to the character at the start of each round. If enhanced with enhanced enchantment this is increased to 45.

Duplicate Armor.name: Duplicate Armor
Duplicate Armor.description: The wearer can give someone a temporary copy of their own armor without the duplicate enchantment once between rest periods (lasts 8 hours.)

Enhanced Enchantment.name: Enhanced Enchantment
Enhanced Enchantment.description: The wearer can give someone a temporary copy of their own armor without the duplicate enchantment once between rest periods (lasts 8 hours.)

Unique Weapon.name: Unique Weapon
Unique Weapon.description: Weapon uses a unique Specialization of your creation.

Musical Weapon.name: Musical Weapon
Musical Weapon.description: The weapon is also an instrument

Double Weapon.name: Double Weapon
Double Weapon.description: Weapon acts as twoacts as two distinct weapons at the same time.

Secret Compartment.name: Secret Compartment
Secret Compartment.description: A secret pocket on the inside of the weapon capable of concealing an item a few inches thick and a few feet long/wide.

Casting.name: Casting
Casting.description: The weapon no longer inhibits casting.

Phial Mount.name: Phial Mount
Phial Mount.description: The weapon can store up to 5 doses of a single type of potion. A dose can be applied to the weapon as per the potion’s writeup as a reaction

Adaptable Weapon.name: Adaptable Weapon
Adaptable Weapon.description: The user can purchase the relevant combat style and weapon specialization using an attribute of the character’s choice, for use with this weapon. The character utilizes the attribute of their choice to set those resistance checks.

Structured Weapon.name: Structured Weapon
Structured Weapon.description: Weapon skill resistance checks set by the character are always 10 + the character’s ranks in crafting (Cannot be further enhanced.)

Collapseable Weapon.name: Collapseable Weapon
Collapseable Weapon.description: The weapon can collapse to be the size of the character’s palm (no weight change) as a swift action.

Steel.name: Steel
Steel.description: +1 of the Weapon’s Damage Type to each attack

Lumil.name: Lumil
Lumil.description: +2 of the Weapon’s Damage Type to each attack

Adamant.name: Adamant
Adamant.description: +3 of the Weapon’s Damage Type to each attack

Orichalcum.name: Orichalcum
Orichalcum.description: Weapon ignores resistance and damage reduction to it’s damage type and can harm ethereal targets.

Selenium.name: Selenium
Selenium.description: The armor can hold double the normal maximum difficulty score of enchantments (20, instead of 10.) Crafter’s ranks in crafting are doubled when working with this material.

Illiastrium.name: Illiastrium
Illiastrium.description: Mundane Damage Reduction 4, Negates a weapon’s bonus damage (Any additional damage beyond base damage die of weapon), unless it is a Magical Damage type; character no longer benefits from armor DVs.

Silvered.name: Silvered
Silvered.description: The weapon is treated as though it were made of Silver.

Auruphyte Coating.name: Auruphyte Coating
Auruphyte Coating.description: Weapon’s Damage Type is changed to Blight.

Soulsteel Coating.name: Soulsteel Coating
Soulsteel Coating.description: Weapon’s Damage Type is changed to Divine.

Serrated Edge.name: Serrated Edge
Serrated Edge.description: The weapon’s base damage is reduced to 0. Instead of inflicting damage, each successful attack inflicts an instance of suffering (of the weapon’s mundane damage type.)

Extending Range.name: Extending Range
Extending Range.description: Increases the reach of a ranged weapon by 40’

Extending Range II.name: Extending Range II
Extending Range II.description: Increases the reach of a ranged weapon by 120’

Extending Reach.name: Extending Reach
Extending Reach.description: Increases the reach of a melee weapon by 5’

Extending Reach II.name: Extending Reach II
Extending Reach II.description: Increases the reach of a melee weapon by 15’

Magical Enchant II.name: Magical Enchant II
Magical Enchant II.description: + 2 bonus to attack rolls, becomes +3 with Magical Enchant I

Magical Affinity.name: Magical Affinity
Magical Affinity.description: Applies any damage bonus granted by the weapon to any attack rolls caused by the casting of a spell. The damage type is reflected by the spell’s damage type.

Warp Mechanism.name: Warp Mechanism
Warp Mechanism.description: Struck targets are Hexed (incapable of teleporation) until the end of their next turn and allows the character to dismiss and summon the item from a pocket dimension as a swift action.

Elemental Property.name: Elemental Property
Elemental Property.description: + 2 Damage of a chosen element type, alters the material/base damage to reflect the elemental property.

Phantom Blade.name: Phantom Blade
Phantom Blade.description: First successful this turn reduces the target’s Mana by 4.

Anima.name: Anima
Anima.description: Evocations are finessed once in a direction of the user’s choosing, when channeling through this weapon.

Illusory Weapon.name: Illusory Weapon
Illusory Weapon.description: The weapon is an intangible illusion with special properties - the user can alter which of the 5 senses it carries as a swift action. The character cannot change the damage, base range, or weapon category that it functions as.

Predictability.name: Predictability
Predictability.description: The weapon’s critical hit value is changed to 11 . The weapon always hits on this number, multiplying all damage done by 1.5x. All other critical hit values lose their effectiveness as critical hits, causing them to inflict normal damage.

Hex of Attachment.name: Hex of Attachment
Hex of Attachment.description: The weapon can be returned to the owners hands as a swift action, if it is within 100’ of the character.

Magnetism.name: Magnetism
Magnetism.description: The weapon is magnetized - causing it to float telekinetically around the character, extending its reach by 5’, though it is still wielded normally. The STR requirement is converted to an equal INT requirement when using the weapon telepathically.

Explosive Weapon.name: Explosive Weapon
Explosive Weapon.description: All within a 10’ radius of the target take 1d12 fire damage (excluding the target), on the first successful strike in a turn.

Shifting Weapon.name: Shifting Weapon
Shifting Weapon.description: All attacks made with the shifting weapon grapple a target, once struck the weapon itself grapples the target, transforming into watery chains. The STR of the chains is 10 + creator’s rank in crafting. When broken, the weapon falls to the ground resuming it’s normal form.

Light as Air.name: Light as Air
Light as Air.description: The STR requirement of the weapon is reduced to 0.

Preservation.name: Preservation
Preservation.description: The weapon’s damage type becomes stress damage. (non-lethal)

Guiding Light.name: Guiding Light
Guiding Light.description: Taking an hour of sun exposure to charge, the wielder can release this sunlight in 20’ radius around themselves as a swift action. It remains there for a minute

Death Toll.name: Death Toll
Death Toll.description: If the target is unconscious or below 0 HP this weapon instead instantly kills the target when they are struck. (Can kill immortal beings who meet the criteria of the attack.)

Dread.name: Dread
Dread.description: This weapon gains a placed roll when attempting to hit a target in darkness and two placed rolls when hitting targets in magical darkness.

Embedded Weapon.name: Embedded Weapon
Embedded Weapon.description: The weapon takes root in one's body. This reduces the amount of arms needed to wield this weapon by 1.

Familiar.name: Familiar
Familiar.description: The weapon gains the ability to transform into a harmless familiar that obeys the wielder. The owner can toggle the ability to see through their familiar’s eyes as a swift action. The familiar must be at least 5’’ x 5’’ and can be up to 5’ x 5’, with a land speed of 30’ or flight speed of 10’ The familiar can be visually different each time it is summoned.

Stormchaser.name: Stormchaser
Stormchaser.description: On a successful spell (above rank 0) attack roll, the wielder of the weapon can teleport anywhere within melee reach of the target

Chaos incarnate.name: Chaos incarnate
Chaos incarnate.description: Inflict chaos bolt on hit, however the weapon forcibly expends 8 HP per chaos effect.

Mimic.name: Mimic
Mimic.description: The weapon has the ability to turn into any weapon the caster can see (perfect replica), as a swift action. The mimic effect wears off after an hour. This can only be used once in between rest periods.

Duplicate.name: Duplicate
Duplicate.description: When this weapon is forged it splits in two, creating two identical weapons. As a swift action, the caster can pull one weapon to the other if it is within 200’ of the other.
